_about: Words the player sees on screen, outside of the story itself.
Things in {curly braces} are filled in by the game; keep them as they are.
look_marker: the colour of the arrow in Look around; look_marker_outline: the colour around it ("" for none).
The story's words (what the narrator says) are in content/dialogue; the drinks are in content/drinks.json.
save_broken, save_newer, save_failed, fresh_done: notes printed in the terminal after you leave, only when something happened to the save file.
title: Coffee and Toe Beans
too_small: The café needs a little more room.
Please make this window at least {need}.
goodbye: The door closes softly behind you. À bientôt.
help: Coffee and Toe Beans: a cosy cat café in your terminal.
coffee-and-toe-beans --color 256     use 256 colours (or truecolor; default: auto)
In the café: ↑ ↓ to choose, Enter to confirm, Esc for the menu.
The café remembers you between visits ({save}).
save_broken: Your old save couldn't be read, so the café started afresh. A copy of it is kept at {path}.
save_newer: Your save came from a newer version of the game. A copy of it is kept at {path}.
save_failed: The café couldn't save this visit: {error}
fresh_done: The café started afresh. Your old save is kept at {path}.
